blocks.text: Salbutamol neb 5mg PRN - short acting beta agonist, opens the airways. Watch for tremor and tachycardia, it's not a sign anything is wrong. Mrs in bed 5 was shaky after two back to back and got upset because she thought it meant her heart was failing. I sat with her and explained it and she settled. I should have warned her BEFORE the second neb.

Peak flow technique - sit up, full breath in, tight seal, hard fast blow. Best of 3. I coached bed 5 through it and her numbers went up 60 L/min once she stopped puffing her cheeks. Recorded on the chart.
Prednisolone 30mg OD for 5 days - steroid, reduces airway inflammation. Take it in the morning with food. Don't stop suddenly if the course is long.
Oxygen - target range written on the chart, 88-92% for the COPD patients. Never just crank it up.
